折.meaning: An <part>anchor</part> pins down a huge map that won't close. An <part>axe</part> waits beside it. One whack straight down the middle, a sharp crease, and the map will finally <kanji>fold</kanji>.
折.on: A <sound>set</sound>ter dog grabs the folded map in its mouth and runs off with it.
折.kun: You fold the paper again and again until it's a tiny paper crane: <sound>ori</sound>gami.

合.meaning: An <part>umbrella</part>-shaped lid drops onto a <part>one</part>-plank rim over a <part>mouth</part>-shaped box. Click! Lid and box were made for each other: a perfect <kanji>fit</kanji>.
合.on: A <sound>goa</sound>t tries the lid on as a hat, and it fits the goat too.
合.kun: '<sound>Ah</sound>! <sound>Ooh</sound>!' you say as the lid clicks into place.

羊.meaning: A <part>king</part> wakes up with curly <part>horns</part> poking out over his crown and wool sprouting down his back. His court tries very hard not to laugh. Overnight he has turned into a <kanji>sheep</kanji>.
羊.on: Stuck as a sheep, the king plays with a <sound>yo</sound>-yo all day to pass the time.
羊.kun: The sheep king charges at the guards' car and <sound>hits</sound> a <sound>jee</sound>p!

着.meaning: A <part>sheep</part> stands on top, and a long <part>slash</part> of yarn runs from its wool down past a big <part>eye</part> that never blinks. The eye watches you knit the yarn into a sweater, row by row. When it's done, you <kanji>don</kanji> it.
着.on: In your new sweater you dance the <sound>cha</sound>-cha, and a <sound>cu</sound>ckoo pops out of the clock to watch.
着.kun: A brass <sound>key</sound> is knitted into the sweater's pocket, next to a little toy kanga<sound>roo</sound>.

遅.meaning: Under a <part>flag</part>, a <part>sheep</part> leads the parade down the <part>ramp</part>, stopping to nibble every patch of grass. The parade behind it crawls. Everything is <kanji>slow</kanji>.
遅.on: A <sound>chee</sound>tah is stuck behind the sheep parade, panting with boredom.
遅.kun: You check the clock as the parade crawls by: '<sound>Oh</sound>! <sound>Cu</sound>ckoo!'

交.meaning: At a party, <part>father</part> wears a paper <part>lid</part> for a hat, his legs crossing as he shuffles from guest to guest. He shakes every hand and joins every chat. He loves to <kanji>mingle</kanji>.
交.on: Father hands every guest an ice cream <sound>co</sound>ne as he passes.
交.kun: Father whirls his old mum across the floor. '<sound>Ma</sound>!' '<sound>Gee</sound>!' they shout.
